notes.title: Major Update for Pornocrates VHS - 2025
notes.content: [p]Pornocrates VHS has been updated with elements more suited to newer versions. Code fixes and cutscenes have been restructured for better FPS performance.[/p]

notes.title: Survive the broadcast — L33na is live and hunting in a ruthless cyber world.
notes.content: [p]Step into L33na’s shoes as she navigates a deadly competition engineered by the mysterious Puritarchs. In this intense cyberpunk universe, your decisions carve your story. Will you betray, ally, or fight to the end? The broadcast awaits your moves.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: L33na – A New Game Coming Soon. Wishlist it now!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like URP and HDRP, and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience.[/p][p]While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future.[/p][p]For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900551/3dd2b276cfffa8415ff33684b29c5ad69d0ec140.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: P VHS - Huge Update August 25
notes.content:
We are releasing the latest Update for Pornocrates VHS. There will be 3 major releases monthly. Each release fixes a problem or adds something new.
This first Update fixes FPS performance issues (mainly at the level that breaks within the club).

notes.title: Huge Update for June 22
notes.content:
This is the first in a series of updates for this game. [b]Orgipix Studios[/b] is focused on improving all the games that have been released so far.
[b]Other updates will come as soon as possible.
Attention[/b]
The next update will be to fix the low FPS count in the third and fourth levels of the game.
